name: @local/dsh-memories
description: Personal DSH memory: every new session is injected with a how-to-use-your-memories guide that drives the agent to write memories itself, unprompted — user corrections and preferences, repeated topics and decisions, wrap-up durable facts — routed project-specific → workspace and cross-project → long, de-duplicated against the injected index; a global long-term index, a global short-term note, and a workspace memory index are injected whole and uncapped, composed read-only from memory files carrying a one-line Description; scripts/generate-index.mjs regenerates the current workspace's INDEX.md on demand — the plugin never writes it; the /memory command and the agent memory tool write and preview memories; the Memories right-sidebar tab lists all memories and shows each one's full content on a detail page, scoped to the current session's workspace.
